tasks.title: Map and generate ML-KEM cryptanalytic mechanisms

handoff.objective: Map the current ML-KEM cryptanalytic baseline and produce one novelty-screened, falsifiable algorithmic candidate.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a concrete mechanism beyond parameter-estimator tuning plausibly changes attack complexity or concrete cost.
inputs: The persistent goal and research question
Public primary literature and standards available as of 2026-07-22
constraints: Separate established literature, derivation, speculation, and proposed tests.
Cite primary sources with stable URLs and record access dates.
Distinguish core cryptanalysis from implementation side channels and oracle-dependent attacks.
Charge samples, preprocessing, memory, reduction, decoding, and verification.
Make no breakthrough claim and change no official state.
completion_gate: The baseline map covers standardized parameter sets and major classical and quantum attack families.
The candidate is deduplicated against cited literature.
The mechanism has explicit assumptions, predictions, full-cost boundary, and one cheap falsification gate.

handoff.objective: Commit and verify the exact exploration artifacts before independent review.

constraints: Run alone and stage only declared producer and receipt paths.
completion_gate: Git verifies the parent, paths, hashes, task ID, and reachable commit.

handoff.objective: Independently verify sources, reconstruct the candidate reasoning, and assess whether it merits experiment design.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the baseline and proposed mechanism are technically correct, novel enough, and falsifiable.
constraints: Reconstruct central equations and cost accounting.
Change no producer artifact or official state.
completion_gate: Every material claim receives a supported, unsupported, or uncertain verdict.
The report identifies the cheapest decisive next gate.

handoff.objective: Try to falsify novelty, oracle assumptions, scaling, and full-cost advantage of the proposed ML-KEM mechanism.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether hidden costs, known attacks, estimator artifacts, or unrealistic access explain the candidate.
constraints: Distinguish absence of evidence from impossibility.
Check all standardized parameter sets and explicit oracle models.

tasks.title: Archive the reviewed ML-KEM batch decision

handoff.objective: Archive independent reviews, scoped evidence, the batch decision, and persistent-goal checkpoint.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether BATCH-001 yields an admissible experiment or derivation task.
inputs: Both independent review packages and the verified producer snapshot
constraints: Only the Coordinator may write official records.

completion_gate: Evidence, decision, and goal records preserve the exact reviewed scope.
The verified ledger commit records exactly one next action.
